mapper.insert: INSERT INTO translation_cache ( user_id, resource_type, resource_id, field_name, source_language, target_language, source_hash, source_text, translated_text, provider, model ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{targetLanguage}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceText}, #{translatedText}, #{provider}, #{model} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), source_text = VALUES(source_text), translated_text = VALUES(translated_text), provider = VALUES(provider), model = VALUES(model), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
